page.overview:
Who is Battle Patrol Team?

The Battle Patrol Team is an Autobot Micromaster Team that appeared in Transformers Zone

The team was present during the Decepticon attack on the Zone Base to steal the Autobot’s Energon Z. The group was in the rocket with the Supercar Patrol Team Cain, Emusa, Rabbicrater, and Moonradar that got attacked by BlackZarak who deployed a laser net. The Jet Patrol Team saved the day by cutting the laser net and Sunrunner used his radar to find out where the Decepticons are heading. The later fought the Decepticons on earth and were present at Dai Atlas’s coronation. Category:Micromaster teams Category:Autobots Category:Zone characters
